app.title: Rights & Entitlements Checker
app.tagline: Find government schemes your household may qualify for.

common.disclaimer: Likely means you may qualify. The government office makes the final decision.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.intro: We ask a few questions about your household to find schemes that may apply.
consent.point1: We do not ask for your name, phone number or Aadhaar number.
consent.point2: You can answer "I don't know" to any question.
consent.point3: You can erase your answers at any time from Saved results.

household.title: Who lives in your household?
household.intro: Add each person. Pick an occupation and we will ask only the questions that matter.

land.help: Land in the name of any family member counts.

tax.text: Did anyone in your household pay income tax last year?
tax.help: Think of the last assessment year.

pension.text: Does anyone get a pension of Rs 10,000 or more every month?
pension.help: Add up all pensions of one person.

bpl.text: Does your household have a BPL (below poverty line) card or status?
bpl.help: Your state office confirms this later.
